actual_scope: Can the production research/prime-power-cyclic-inverse/verify.py adopt the proved exact zero-coefficient row skip from research/cyclic-zero-elimination/ so that the shipped eight-case cyclic-inverse replay is faster while every EXPECTED.json receipt field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, R420 rref/geometry/mutants, frameopt.close, leech_minor, verify_factor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine for #1076, data_corners, clifford_exact, bit-hosted-digest, emitted-local hpe_audit_local, e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST-only edits) were skipped. Frame-pair production was deferred due to many VERIFY live pins with working-tree sha checks. thakrarsagar's merged #736 opt-in adapter already proved ~1.59× wall on the complete eight-case cyclic-inverse replay with identical receipts; production research/prime-power-cyclic-inverse/verify.py still performed zero-coefficient row updates. This session wires that equivalent skip into the shipped verifier and vendors pairwise baseline bytes into both the production package and the historical opt-in adapter.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the cyclic-inverse verifier is a retained exact historical check. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production eliminate() zero-row skip with frozen baseline, identical EXPECTED.json receipts, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_CYCLIC_ZERO_PRODUCTION via research/cyclic-zero-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_CYCLIC_ZERO_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5; cyclic-zero-elimination vendors baseline.py and reads pairwise bytes from that copy.
